feature: Range-aware attack scoring with preferred, backup, and desperate tactic stages

policy.rangePenalty: Any non-zero range-increment penalty is a major utility cost when a useful approach exists
policy.maximumPenalty: A -10 ranged attack remains legal only as a low-value desperate option when no useful approach exists
policy.comparison: Ranged utility is evaluated against the actor's best melee alternative and the value of closing distance
policy.approachSafety: Closing routes with excessive hazard or reaction exposure are not treated as useful alternatives
policy.fallback: Later tactic stages are evaluated only when an earlier stage produces no useful action
policy.deliberateHold: Hiding, lay-low, and avoiding plans can deliberately hold position without triggering an offensive fallback

newCoverage: a penalized ranged attack loses to a useful approach
maximum-range attacks remain available only when closing is unavailable
blocked but viable detours remain approach candidates
preferred, backup, and desperate tactic stages resolve in order
deliberate stealth and avoidance holds do not fall through
older saved behavior sets migrate to the new ranged components
the decision graph renders ranged and tactic-stage cards
